project_type: Rust Cargo workspace (hybrid orchestrator core) + TypeScript/Vite frontend for a Tauri desktop app. Phase 3 implements the built-in MCP client (architecture.md Section 5).
build_system: cargo (workspace at hybrid-orchestrator/Cargo.toml). QUIRK: crates that carry crates.io deps are under [workspace] exclude (not members) so bare offline cargo commands stay green; CI builds them explicitly via --manifest-path crates/<name>/Cargo.toml. Excluded crates pin concrete version literals (cannot use {workspace=true}). Offline members currently: mcp-client, routing. mcp-client will MOVE to exclude in Phase 3 once it gains crates.io deps.
test_framework: Rust: built-in cargo test + tokio::test async harness; providers uses wiremock for mocked HTTP/SSE and fixture byte buffers (never live network). Frontend: vitest.
build_command: cd hybrid-orchestrator && cargo build --workspace (offline members only). For mcp-client after it becomes excluded: cargo build --manifest-path crates/mcp-client/Cargo.toml (REQUIRES NETWORK - CI only). For orchestrator-core: cargo build --manifest-path crates/orchestrator-core/Cargo.toml (CI only).
test_command: cd hybrid-orchestrator && cargo test --workspace (offline members). Networked crates in CI: cargo test --manifest-path crates/<name>/Cargo.toml. fmt is offline-runnable: cargo fmt --manifest-path crates/mcp-client/Cargo.toml --check.
verification_instructions: Offline (in sandbox): (1) cargo build --workspace stays green with mcp-client REMOVED from members (it becomes an excluded crate). (2) cargo fmt --manifest-path crates/mcp-client/Cargo.toml --check and same for orchestrator-core must pass (rustfmt needs no network). (3) From frontend/: NODE_OPTIONS= prettier --check . must pass. FULL compile/test/clippy of mcp-client and orchestrator-core is DEFERRED TO CI (crates.io deps unreachable offline: HTTP 403). Document offline-verified vs CI-deferred in the summary.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in. package-lock.json is intentionally absent (generated on first networked CI run). Cargo.lock at hybrid-orchestrator/Cargo.lock only covers offline members.
setup_instructions: Work on branch phase-3-mcp-client (already created off main). All cargo commands run from /projects/agent-harbor/hybrid-orchestrator. No dependency install possible offline; rely on already-vendored offline members and defer networked builds to CI.
environment_constraints: Network mode INTEGRATIONS_ONLY: crates.io and npm registry return HTTP 403. Cannot compile crates needing crates.io deps offline; Tauri CLI not installed. mcp-client's new deps (tokio, serde_json, reqwest for HTTP/SSE, etc.) are crates.io-only, so mcp-client + orchestrator-core compile/test/clippy are CI-deferred. rustfmt and the global prettier CAN run locally. CI matrix is [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest] ONLY (macOS removed - do NOT re-add). stdio-transport tests that spawn a child process MUST be cross-platform (Linux + Windows): spawn the test binary itself (std::env::current_exe) or a portable command; avoid Unix-only shell invocations; account for Windows .exe semantics.
contribution_requirements: clippy -D warnings must be clean (no dead_code/unused imports/useless_vec/collapsible_if/needless Debug-format). Add scoped #[allow(dead_code)] with a 'wired in Phase N' note ONLY for genuinely-unused-yet items; remove when used. Derive Debug on types that tests {:?}-format; never Debug-format trait objects. rustfmt clean incl. alphabetically-ordered pub use re-exports. Prettier clean for frontend. .gitattributes enforces LF. For serde types crossing IPC or persisted: #[serde(rename_all="camelCase")] AND per-variant rename_all="camelCase" for internally-tagged enums (enum-level does not cascade to fields). skip_serializing_if for empty Vecs/Options. Keep frontend/src/types/index.ts TS mirror in exact sync (single-line unions if <=100 cols).
key_patterns: providers/src/contract.rs owns ToolSpec (ToolSpec::function(name,desc,params_json)), FunctionSpec, ToolCall{id,kind,function:FunctionCall{name,arguments:String}}, ChatRequest{tools:Vec<ToolSpec>,...}, ChatMessage{role,content,tool_calls,tool_call_id,name} with ChatMessage::text(role,content), MessageRole{System,User,Assistant,Tool}. providers/src/crypto.rs::ensure_crypto_provider() installs ring rustls default (call before building any reqwest client). providers/src/capability.rs::HttpSseClient + sse_event_stream show the reqwest (default-features=false, features=[json,stream,rustls-tls]) + SSE decoder pattern to REUSE for http_sse transport. domain/src/models.rs owns McpServerConfig{id,name,transport:McpTransport,permission_mode:PermissionMode,enabled}, McpTransport::{Stdio{command,args,env:Vec<(String,String)>}, HttpSse{url,headers:Vec<(String,String)>}} (internally-tagged, camelCase), PermissionMode::{Ask,Allow,Deny}, ToolCall{id,name,arguments:Value}, ToolResult{call_id,content:Value,is_error}. orchestrator-core/src/events.rs owns CoreEvent (11 variants incl. McpStateChanged{server_id,state:McpConnectionState}, McpError{server_id,message}, PermissionRequested{request_id,server_id,tool_name,mode,rationale}) and McpConnectionState{Connecting,Connected,Disconnected}. orchestrator-core already depends on mcp-client (path dep) and re-exports domain models.
directory_structure: hybrid-orchestrator/ is the Rust workspace root. crates/: domain (leaf DTOs), orchestrator-core (SessionManager, CoreEvent, pipeline), persistence (sqlx), secrets, providers (ChatProvider + adapters, FULLY built), mcp-client (PLACEHOLDER - Phase 3 fills this: src/{lib.rs,session.rs,tools.rs,transport/{stdio.rs,http_sse.rs}}), routing (placeholder), tauri-app (AppState, commands, event bridge). frontend/ is the Vite/TS app with mirrored types in src/types/index.ts. .github/workflows/ci.yml is the authoritative build gate on [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest].
